scope: Operational coverage only; frozen996scientific verdicts and original reviewed packet/paper unchanged. No new fits or diagnostics. Root review pending.

definitions.pending: Exact target-specific assessment unrun/unestablished; inspecting related evidence is not a production attempt.
definitions.attempted-incomplete: A bounded pilot, diagnostic, software check or restricted argument exists; full exact target remains open.
definitions.completed-attempt: Declared numerical or analytical attempt complete; scientific comparability, source reproduction or broad inference may remain unresolved.
definitions.completed: Narrow reviewed target completed under explicit assumptions.
definitions.blocked: Independent exact target requires documented unavailable input; feasible source-only arithmetic or reconstructed subwork may remain.

honest_limits: Counts are dependent inventory rows, not independent studies, successes or a compute forecast.
No new unavailable-resource conclusion is inferred from pilot timings. Failed one-case joint convergence motivates validated remedial work, not automatic abandonment of all100/250-dataset targets.
Original source stopping fields and prior v2work status are preserved for audit, even where generic/inapplicable stopping language required more conservative v3classification.
Some qualitative source targets lack a unique criterion. Their pending status requires interpretation/analysis, not arbitrary new post-hoc success margins.
Blocked empirical rows can coexist with feasible printed-count arithmetic; independent empirical targets stay blocked without relabeling source reuse as replication.
No blanket completed status is assigned to nonblocked claims. Narrow ordinary proofs do not close broad identifiability, power or empirical claims.
byte_normalization: CSV line endings normalized to LF to agree with Git stored artifact; cell content unchanged.
